description:
YouTube
==
- feat(YouTube - Change start page): Add more start page https://github.com/inotia00/revanced-patches/pull/115
- feat(YouTube - Navigation bar components): Revert - 'Add `Disable translucent status bar` setting, Separate `Enable translucent navigation bar setting` into `Disable light translucent bar` and `Disable dark translucent bar settings`' (Close https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2604 https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2607)
- feat(YouTube - Seekbar components):  If the `Custom braning icon` patch is included and the patch option `Restore old splash animation` is enabled, it will not change the Seekbar color from the original splash animation (Lottie animation)
- feat(YouTube - Spoof streaming data): Add setting to change `PoToken / Visitor Data` https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2630#issuecomment-2566310025
- feat(YouTube - Spoof streaming data): Remove `Use Android clients only` setting, restore `Force iOS AVC` setting
- fix(YouTube - Custom branding icon):  Restrict the version that can use the patch options `Change splash icons` to YouTube 19.16.39 (Close https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2605)
- fix(YouTube - Disable haptic feedback): `Disable seek haptic feedback` doesn't work https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2579
- fix(YouTube - Hide feed components): Your Movies is empty when turning on `Hide carousel shelf` https://github.com/inotia00/revanced-patches/pull/116
- fix(YouTube - Miniplayer): Patched app crashes after first launch or clearing data (Close https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2604 https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2607)
- fix(YouTube - Overlay buttons): Restrict the version that can use the patch options `Bottom margin` and `Wider between-buttons space` to YouTube 19.16.39 (Close https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2608)
- fix(YouTube - Return YouTube Dislike): Match with ReVanced (Close https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2611)
- fix(YouTube - Swipe controls): Gestures are not disabled in the channel bar even though `Disable watch panel gestures` is turned on (YouTube 19.16.39+)


YouTube Music
==
- feat(YouTube Music - Spoof streaming data): Remove `Android Creator` and `iOS Music`, add `Android Music` (Close https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2617)
- fix(YouTube Music - Custom header): Not working on YouTube Music 7.25.53 https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2612
- fix(YouTube Music - Spoof streaming data): Last selected value is not remembered in ListPreference Dialog


Shared
==
- fix: In app strings and patch descriptions https://github.com/inotia00/revanced-patches/pull/114
- fix(GmsCore support): Do not show battery optimization error on Android Automotive devices (Google built-in)
- fix(Spoof streaming data): Ignore exception if hide ads is disabled
- fix(Spoof streaming data): Specify language code only for clients that cannot log in


Announcement
==
- YouTube Music's support version has been upgraded to **7.25.53**, but please read the following issue and upgrade only if necessary: https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/2554.
- Compatible ReVanced Manager: [RVX Manager v1.23.5 (fork)](https://github.com/inotia00/revanced-manager/releases/tag/v1.23.5).
